description:
Who works full-time or part-time, who is unemployed and looking, and who is outside the workforce, with the unemployment and participation rates, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,500 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few people or homes for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/labour-force`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_aged_15_plus, employed_count, employed_pct, employed_full_time_count, employed_full_time_pct, employed_part_time_count, employed_part_time_pct, employed_away_from_work_count, employed_away_from_work_pct, unemployed_count, unemployed_pct, labour_force_count, labour_force_pct, not_in_labour_force_count, not_in_labour_force_pct, unemployment_rate. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_area_stats_labour_force
title: Suburb · Labour force status
